name: bing-ads-performance-report
description: Use for "how are my Microsoft Ads doing", "how are my Bing Ads doing", "why did my Bing cost per lead go up", "which Microsoft Ads campaigns improved this month", "am I losing impression share on Bing", "what happened to my Microsoft Ads last week", or a weekly or monthly account check — even when the user never says "review". Also use when someone wants to know what changed in the account and why, or needs the baseline read before deciding anything else. Microsoft Ads (Bing) only.
